🚀 Join the EdTech Revolution: We are looking for a B2B Sales & Marketing Specialist!
Are you passionate about the future of education? Do you want to be a strategic partner who empowers educational institutions to transform their teaching methods through AI and SaaS?
We are growing our team and looking for a dynamic
B2B Sales & Marketing Specialist
to help bring our
ClassIn
smart-classroom solutions to the next level. If you are a sales-driven professional who loves technology and believes in the power of EdTech, we want to hear from you.
[The Role: More Than Just Sales]
This isn’t a traditional "hard-sell" role. You will be a consultant, a strategist, and a partner to our clients.
🎯 What You’ll Do:
Drive B2B Growth:
Manage the full sales cycle for ClassIn solutions (SaaS, AI features, Smart Classrooms), from prospecting to closing and ongoing account management.
Architect Educational Success:
Consult with educational institutions to design their digital transformation strategy (Online, Offline, or OMO models).
Leverage Data & AI:
Use CRM tools and data insights to refine sales strategies. Utilize AI-powered tools for content creation, market research, and maximizing operational efficiency.
Amplify Our Brand:
Support marketing initiatives by creating compelling case studies, hosting webinars, and representing us at industry trade shows and events.
✅ Who You Are:
A strong communicator who builds lasting relationships with partners and clients.
A problem-solver who is eager to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment.
Someone with a genuine interest in EdTech, SaaS, and the latest AI technologies.
(Preferred) Experience in B2B SaaS, Education industry, CRM management, or content marketing.
🌟 Why Join Us?
Be a Growth Driver:
You won't just follow a process; you will help define the sales and marketing strategy.
AI-First Culture:
We actively integrate the latest AI tools into our daily workflows.
Meaningful Impact:
Your work directly helps teachers and students create better learning experiences.
